<function name="IsOnFire" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether the entity is on fire.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the entity is on fire or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Demonstrates the use of this function.</description>
	<code>print( Entity(1):IsOnFire() )</code>
	<output>Outputs 'true' to the console if the player 1 is on fire.</output>

</example>
